name: Matted Sandmat
desc: Matted Sandmat (Euphorbia serpens): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Euphorbia serpens is a species of Euphorbia known by the common name matted sandmat. It is native to the Americas but it can be found on most continents as an introduced species and often a weed.
